lines.intro: This is the Experiments tab of your forge. Four steps: a baseline, one change, the same questions again, then before and after.
lines.baseline: Run 1 is the shipped toolbox: our baseline. Six of six right.
lines.pick: Under Change one thing, pick: vague descriptions on every tool. Each tool now says almost nothing about what it does.
lines.settings: Your settings list the change. Nothing else is different.
lines.run: Run the six questions again. It takes about a minute. Here it is sped up.
lines.result: Before and after: run 2 against run 1. What to notice: the same score, six of six. The cost moved instead.
lines.tiles: One more tool call, fifteen instead of fourteen, and about four thousand more tokens in, even though every description is now shorter.
lines.table: Yellow cells show where the model chose differently. On questions 3 and 6 it also called check stock, which neither question needs. With vague descriptions the model has less to go on, so it tries more tools.
lines.next: Next: try another change, or set one by hand on the Anvil. After two or three knobs, go on to the Shield.
